import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
files = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files'], text=True).splitlines()
scenario = '''
import copy
import json
from api import list_destinations
from migration import migrate_batch
from writer import new_destination

records = json.load(open('data/records.json'))
expected = [
    {'id': 'legacy-a', 'address': 'a@example.test'},
    {'id': 'current-b', 'address': 'b@example.test'},
    {'id': 'legacy-c', 'address': 'c@example.test'},
]

def check(label, rows, want):
    before = copy.deepcopy(rows)
    try:
        got = list_destinations(rows)
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f'{label}: FAIL {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}')
    else:
        assert got == want, (label, got, want)
        print(f'{label}: PASS {got}')
    assert rows == before, f'{label}: reader changed records'

check('empty list', [], [])
check('new write', [new_destination('new', 'new@example.test')],
      [{'id': 'new', 'address': 'new@example.test'}])
check('current-only', [records[1]], [expected[1]])
check('legacy-only', [records[0]], [expected[0]])
check('mixed initial', records, expected)
assert migrate_batch(records, 0) == 0
check('zero migration limit', records, expected)
assert migrate_batch(records, 1) == 1
assert 'destination' in records[0] and 'address' in records[2]
check('after first bounded batch', records, expected)
assert migrate_batch(records, 1) == 1
check('migration complete', records, expected)
assert migrate_batch(records, 1) == 0
check('migration rerun', records, expected)
'''
for label, revision in [('HEAD baseline', 'HEAD:'), ('staged candidate', ':')]:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='destination-review-') as temp:
        dest = pathlib.Path(temp)
        for file in files:
            target = dest / file
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', revision + file], cwd=root))
        print(f'REVISION: {label}', flush=True)
        suite = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '-m', 'unittest', 'discover', '-s', 'tests', '-v'], cwd=dest, text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        print(suite.stdout, end='', flush=True)
        assert suite.returncode == 0
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '-c', scenario], cwd=dest, text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        print(result.stdout, end='', flush=True)
        assert result.returncode == 0
